name: Tarba
found: Clay pits, behind the fourth kiln.
appearance: 16. Clay-grey to the eyebrows. Burn blisters.
sayings: Goblins'll dig all night if you keep the kiln lit.
wants: Cheap hands for the clay pits.
does_not_want: Halbet learning goblins carry his clay.
knows: Goblins tend a kiln better than he does.
dm_notes: The Ashfang trained them as fire-tenders. They never let a fire die.
